headline: Tk 2.5 lakh crore for Metro Rail expansion and new project
summary: Ecnec has approved the construction of MRT Line-5 (Southern) and revisions to MRT Line-1 and Line-5 (Northern), totaling an investment of around Tk 2.5 lakh crore.
details: The Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (Ecnec) has approved a new project for the construction of MRT Line-5 (Southern) and revisions to existing MRT Line-1 and MRT Line-5 (Northern) projects.
The total estimated cost for these three Metro Rail projects is approximately Tk 2.5 lakh crore.
The newly proposed MRT Line-5 (Southern) project, spanning 17.20km, will be financed by the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and cost an estimated Tk 45,503 crore.
The revised MRT Line-1 project, covering 31.24km, is funded by Japan and will cost Tk 1,14,394.89 crore.
The revised MRT Line-5 (Northern) project, 20km in length, has a total outlay of of Tk 89,848.36 crore.
The approvals were granted during an Ecnec meeting chaired by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.
caption:
Tk 2.5 lakh crore investment for Metro Rail expansion! 

Ecnec has approved a new line and revisions to two others.

The Executive Committee of the National Economic Council (Ecnec) has approved a new project for the construction of MRT Line-5 (Southern) and revisions to existing MRT Line-1 and MRT Line-5 (Northern) projects.

The total estimated cost for these three Metro Rail projects is approximately Tk 2.5 lakh crore.

The newly proposed MRT Line-5 (Southern) project, spanning 17.20km, will be financed by the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and cost an estimated Tk 45,503 crore.

The revised MRT Line-1 project, covering 31.24km, is funded by Japan and will cost Tk 1,14,394.89 crore.

The revised MRT Line-5 (Northern) project, 20km in length, has a total outlay of of Tk 89,848.36 crore.

The approvals were granted during an Ecnec meeting chaired by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.

headline_marked: Two SC lawyers [[summoned over alleged contempt]] of ICT-2 verdict
headline: Two SC lawyers summoned over alleged contempt of ICT-2 verdict
summary: The International Crimes Tribunal-2 has ordered M Hasanuzzaman Tushar and Barrister Mohammad Hasan Chowdhury to appear and explain their remarks.
details: The International Crimes Tribunal-2 (ICT-2) has summoned two Supreme Court lawyers to appear before the court. They must explain alleged contemptuous remarks regarding a recent tribunal verdict.
import The lawyers, identified as M Hasanuzzaman Tushar and Barrister Mohammad Hasan Chowdhury, have been directed to appear before the tribunal on September 23.
The order follows allegations of contempt raised by Prosecutor Gazi Monawar Hossain Tamim against the two legal professionals.
The tribunal clarified that it will first hear the statements of the two lawyers before deciding if their remarks actually constitute contempt of court.
The controversy stems from a verdict delivered by ICT-2 yesterday, which sentenced Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader and six others to death.
This death sentence was handed down in a crimes against humanity case involving atrocities committed during the July Uprising in 2024.
